name: GENIUS ROOFING SOLUTIONS LLC
address: 7300 W Camino Real, Boca Raton, FL 33433, United States

reviews_verbatim_used.author: Randall Stenhoff
reviews_verbatim_used.text: When I suffered damage from the recent tornados I called everyone and it seemed they were taking advantage of the situation. Then I reached out to GENIUS ROOFING and couldn't believe the honesty and professionalism they gave me and I was blown away by the quality of their work. I recommend them to all my friends

reviews_verbatim_used.author: Daryl Jones
reviews_verbatim_used.text: Great people to work with they did an awesome job on my roof!!
